recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century soul music album cover featuring a central figure in a white gown against a dark, lush botanical background, framed by bold primary-colored typography at the top and elegant script in the center-left.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast white subject against deep green/black foliage
Primary red slab-serif title anchoring the top edge
Yellow script subtitle providing a decorative counterpoint to the central figure

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical figure, full-length, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white dress acts as the primary focal point, with the red text at the top serving as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: from the red title, down to the yellow script, following the line of the white dress to the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows and dense foliage provide a heavy, textured negative space surrounding the subject.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subject and background; high saturation in the primary-colored text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Condensed Slab Serif and Formal Script
letterConstructionRules: Title: Tall, condensed proportions with heavy, flat slab serifs.
Subtitle: High-contrast copperplate-style script with exaggerated swashes and loops.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, masculine slab serif with a fluid, feminine script.
graphicDevices: Small metadata text in the top right corner
Small circular logo/badge in the bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif aesthetic of the 1960s.
Provides the necessary calligraphic elegance and swashes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, soft-focus photograph of a woman in a long white halter-neck gown standing in a dark, dense garden at night. The lighting should be low-key, highlighting the white fabric against dark green leaves.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, bold red condensed slab-serif title at the top. Add a yellow calligraphic script subtitle in the middle-left area with a slight upward angle and a subtle black drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the red title condensed and slab-serif?
Is the yellow text a high-contrast script?
Is the background dark and botanical?
Is the central figure wearing a bright white gown?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not obscure the face of the subject.
Verify the red and yellow colors are vibrant against the dark background.
Check that the overall image has a vintage, printed-paper texture.
Confirm the white dress is the brightest element in the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key botanical portrait with a top-aligned slab-serif title and a mid-aligned decorative script in primary colors.
